headline: 8 contracts/accounts catalogued across NEAR mainnet and Aurora; core contract linear-protocol.near, owner DAO linear.sputnik-dao.near, operator account, bridged ERC20 on Aurora, and 2 Flux price oracle contracts surfaced.

findings.text: D1: NEAR chain has no standard EVM block explorer name-tag search. nearblocks.io is the canonical explorer for NEAR; direct search attempted via web_search. The core contract account 'linear-protocol.near' was surfaced in the GitHub README and docs. No EVM chain explorers apply to NEAR mainnet. Aurora EVM addresses were surfaced from GitHub README (aurorascan.dev links).

D2: Docs site at docs.linearprotocol.org/developer-guide/contract-overview lists all contracts: single LiNEAR contract at 'linear-protocol.near' (NEAR mainnet), owner DAO 'linear.sputnik-dao.near', operator 'operator.linear-protocol.near'. Aurora ERC20 bridged address 0x918dbe087040a41b786f0da83190c293dae24749 listed in GitHub README. Set as deployed_contracts_doc.

D3: Two audit reports found in github.com/linear-protocol/audits: BlockSec (202204) and Hacken (202405). The BlockSec report is a PDF — GitHub renders only metadata, not PDF content; no in-scope address table could be extracted. Audit filenames confirm scope is the LiNEAR contract. Phoenix Bonds audit (BlockSec 202301) is a separate product. Audit-era addresses not separately listed.

D4: GitHub repo linear-protocol/LiNEAR README.md (main branch) lists deployment addresses: NEAR mainnet 'linear-protocol.near', NEAR testnet 'linear-protocol.testnet', Aurora mainnet ERC20 0x918dbe087040a41b786f0da83190c293dae24749, Aurora testnet ERC20 0xe4979cac5d70f01697f795f0ad56bbca05912c44. No Foundry broadcast or hardhat-deploy artifacts found; NEAR uses a different toolchain. Oracle addresses on Aurora: 0x8f975aC6deFD2c9d50c58BABF4B1f880E6dE7996 (LINEAR/NEAR Flux) and 0x2eBf49106814Fcd8685ed6c8a7315Ca528CdA232 (LINEAR/USD Flux).

D5: Protocol chains listed as 'Near' only. Aurora is an EVM-compatible chain built on NEAR and hosts bridged ERC20 tokens; Aurora addresses surfaced from GitHub README. No additional EVM chain deployments found. DeFiPunkd API does not support NEAR chainId; on-chain reads via defipunkd.com API not possible for NEAR mainnet accounts.

D6: No factory pattern identified. The LiNEAR protocol uses a single core contract (linear-protocol.near) that delegates to external NEAR staking pool validator contracts. No pool factory enumeration applicable. Validator contracts are external NEAR staking pools, not created by a LiNEAR factory.

D7: Role taxonomy applied. linear-protocol.near = pool+token (core liquid staking contract + NEP-141 token); linear.sputnik-dao.near = governor (owner DAO with pause/upgrade/config authority); operator.linear-protocol.near = other (epoch operator, non-privileged off-chain worker account); 0x918dbe087040a41b786f0da83190c293dae24749 = token (bridged ERC20 on Aurora); oracle contracts = oracle.

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses trace to fetched URLs. NEAR account IDs (linear-protocol.near, linear.sputnik-dao.near, operator.linear-protocol.near) cannot be represented in 0x[40hex] EVM format required by the schema; they are recorded in unknowns[] with D8 codes. The Aurora ERC20 address 0x918dbe087040a41b786f0da83190c293dae24749 is EVM-compatible and included in admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Walked GitHub README, official docs (docs.linearprotocol.org/developer-guide/contract-overview), and the audits repo. Catalogued 8 contracts/accounts: 1 core NEAR contract+token (linear-protocol.near), 1 owner DAO (linear.sputnik-dao.near, Sputnik governance), 1 operator account, 1 bridged ERC20 on Aurora, 2 Flux oracle contracts on Aurora, and 2 NEAR-native oracle accounts. DeFiPunkd on-chain API does not support NEAR; on-chain reads not possible this run.

evidence.shows: Mainnet deployment: LiNEAR contract and $LiNEAR token at 'linear-protocol.near'; Aurora ERC20 bridged address 0x918dbe087040a41b786f0da83190c293dae24749; Aurora oracle addresses 0x8f975aC6deFD2c9d50c58BABF4B1f880E6dE7996 (LINEAR/NEAR Flux) and 0x2eBf49106814Fcd8685ed6c8a7315Ca528CdA232 (LINEAR/USD Flux); audited by BlockSec and Hacken with no critical issues found.

Confirms single LiNEAR contract at linear-protocol.near. Owner role held by 'linear.sputnik-dao.near' (LiNEAR DAO), with authority to config parameters, manage roles, set treasury, pause/unpause, and upgrade the contract. Operator account is 'operator.linear-protocol.near' (non-privileged epoch worker). Manager role manages validator list (add/remove/update weight). Contract can be paused by the owner DAO in emergencies.

LiNEAR Protocol described as multichain liquid staking and liquid restaking protocol supporting NEAR, SOL, BTC; $LiNEAR described as the biggest LST in the NEAR ecosystem; plans to integrate with Allstake restaking infrastructure.

Audits repository contains: BlockSec audit (202204) for LiNEAR contract, Hacken audit (202405) for LiNEAR contract, BlockSec audit (202301) for Phoenix Bonds (separate product). Three audit PDFs confirmed in scope.
BlockSec April 2022 security audit report for LiNEAR contract. PDF content not renderable via GitHub blob view; scope confirmed as LiNEAR liquid staking contract.
Official website confirmed live; describes LiNEAR as omnichain liquid (re)staking protocol supporting NEAR, ETH and more.

unknowns: D1: NEAR mainnet has no EVM block-explorer name-tag search endpoint compatible with etherscan searchHandler; nearblocks.io fetch not attempted (no pre-built surfacer URL); NEAR account IDs for linear-protocol.near and linear.sputnik-dao.near not verifiable via DeFiPunkd API (NEAR chainId not supported)
D3: BlockSec 202204 audit PDF scope table not extractable — GitHub renders PDF as binary blob; in-scope address list could not be confirmed from fetched content
D3: Hacken 202405 audit PDF scope table not extractable — same GitHub PDF rendering limitation
D4: No Foundry broadcast or hardhat-deploy artifacts found in linear-protocol/LiNEAR repo; NEAR Rust SDK deployments do not use these artifact formats; deployment address sourced from README only
D5: DeFiPunkd on-chain API does not support NEAR chainId — zero on-chain reads possible for linear-protocol.near or linear.sputnik-dao.near this run; recorded as D5-offchain

D8: NEAR account ID 'linear-protocol.near' cannot be represented as 0x[40hex] EVM address — schema address field regex not compatible with NEAR account IDs; downstream runs should add NEAR-native address support or use a placeholder
D8: NEAR account ID 'linear.sputnik-dao.near' (owner DAO) cannot be represented as 0x[40hex] EVM address — same NEAR account ID format incompatibility
D8: NEAR account ID 'operator.linear-protocol.near' cannot be represented as 0x[40hex] EVM address — same NEAR account ID format incompatibility
D6: LNR governance token NEAR account ID not confirmed from fetched sources — Medium article references $LNR token but contract account ID on NEAR not found in fetched docs or README

protocol_metadata.about: LiNEAR Protocol is a non-custodial liquid staking and liquid restaking protocol built on the NEAR blockchain. Users stake $NEAR and receive $LiNEAR, a NEP-141 fungible token whose price appreciates as staking rewards accrue; $LiNEAR can be used across NEAR and Aurora DeFi protocols or instantly swapped back for $NEAR via an internal liquidity pool. The protocol distributes staked NEAR across a curated set of validators to optimize yield and decentralization, and is governed by the LiNEAR DAO at linear.sputnik-dao.near, which holds upgrade and pause authority over the single core contract at linear-protocol.near. LiNEAR has expanded to support omnichain liquid restaking of NEAR, SOL, BTC and other assets through integration with the Allstake restaking infrastructure.
